scope: F3 only; sanitized synthetic measurements, separate new follow-up directory, not frozen live E2E evidence or product qualification

conclusion.observed: Sequential synthetic full preparation and reverification batches were faster after the change.
conclusion.attribution: The same-fixture interleaved hash-only comparison showed only a 2.48% mean wall reduction, overlapping ranges and two slower optimized adjacent pairs. A stable algorithm speedup is not established.
conclusion.notClaimed: No measured real-preflight, five-round business, cleanup or physical-disk-throughput improvement; do not attribute all end-to-end reduction to buffered hashing.
conclusion.delivery: Draft performance experiment with complete safety checks and persistent measurements, not an approval to publish or merge.

revisions.f1f2Integration: merge-tree passed without textual conflicts; no uncommitted code consumed and no combined runtime acceptance claimed

change.mechanism: Extend the existing reusable 1MiB synchronous SHA-256 read buffer to small files; keep short-read handling, reads through EOF and finally-close.
change.benefitBoundary: Avoid whole-file readFileSync buffers; this does not eliminate all allocations or all filesystem metadata work.
unchanged: Initial complete source scan, copy or expected-seed validation, complete source and target byte reverification
SHA-256 schemas, ignored dependencies/build-output detection and final source/target Git identity and cleanliness checks
Link containment, workspace isolation, ownership/approval and retained-copy provenance/one-time consumption
All three approximately 30-second unchanged windows, business assertions, deadlines and cleanup safeguards
change.failureContainment: Both final scan pools settle before a rejection is returned, so cleanup cannot race a still-running sibling pool.

environment.startGate: Three consecutive samples about 20 seconds apart: host CPU below 40%, physical disk below 10MiB/s and 30% busy, foreign Node test CPU below 5%, no detected native acceptance.
environment.limitations: Start gates are not exclusive host reservations or continuous contention monitoring. OS caches are uncontrolled. A waiting gate was stopped, before measurement, when a foreign live preflight appeared.

fullDependencySeedBenchmark.fixture: Four store packages, mixed 1KiB/64KiB files and an internal node_modules junction; own generated fixtures removed after successful measurement.

initialPreparation.scope: Source scan, copy/link rebase, full source/target byte scans and all Git checks; no native selection/typecheck or business cases.
initialPreparation.outlierNotExcluded: After sample 0 retained-source scan took 24.748s, versus baseline 1.821-3.557s. Do not claim every individual scan improved.

preparedReverification.scope: Expected-seed path; all three full scans and all Git checks remain, with no recopy.

fullDependencySeedBenchmark.aggregation: Parent phases include subphases. Source and copied-workspace scans overlap; do not add their wall or process-CPU intervals. dependency-byte-verification stage also includes final Git checks.

sameFixtureHashAttributionBenchmark.scope: Same directory, serial pathFingerprint, 8192 files/140509184 logical bytes per scan, one warm-up per implementation; no Git/copy/worker startup within timed scans.
sameFixtureHashAttributionBenchmark.interpretation: Four small samples per implementation; overlapping ranges and mixed pair directions. No stable p50/p95 or significance claim. This does not establish stable speedup.

persistentProgress.frequency: Stage boundaries and every 10 seconds during hashing, with flushed append-only records; worker file/byte updates at most once per second.
persistentProgress.realWork: Completed planned tasks, successfully hashed files and actual logical bytes; both serial and worker-pool paths are measured.
persistentProgress.timing: Monotonic scan/benchmark wall time plus process cumulative CPU; existing lifecycle stage records retain their wall-clock timestamps/durations.
persistentProgress.cpu: Controller process including worker threads, excluding child Git/robocopy; concurrent intervals overlap.
persistentProgress.processIO: Not measured. Logical hashed bytes are not process IO counters.
persistentProgress.physicalDisk: Host admission counters only, not attributable throughput of this workload.
persistentProgress.deadline: Progress messages do not renew the absolute task timeout.

validation.syntaxAndDiff: Modified JavaScript syntax, evidence JSON parsing and git diff --check passed
validation.failureEdges: Same-length restored-mtime ignored source/target tampering, added ignored build output, escaping/dangling links, failed reads, short reads, cancellation and aliased frozen-evidence destinations
validation.remoteCI: Report actual PR check results separately; local passing checks are not remote CI acceptance.

remainingBottlenecks: Repeated complete scans remain; no Git-only trust, immutable snapshot cache or preparation lifecycle redesign was introduced.
Copying, link rebase, fresh copied-file access and Git checks remain material; sequential batch differences outside hashing are not causally attributed.
Historical cleanup was 93.843s link scanning plus 677.996s git remove, not 774.427s entirely attributable to links; cleanup is unchanged.
No real product restore/fullbuild, native preflight, business five-round run, model call or Aurora invocation was performed.
Existing sealed preflight/Controller qualification is not silently requalified for changed Controller file bytes.
